what_this_shows: From scratch, on 40 rows and 200 steps at 3e-4, the model fits its training rows (record-exact 0.844) but scores 0.000 on 40 disjoint unseen rows. The published unseen numbers therefore depend on the pretrained checkpoint, which is not distributed. This run is a harness check and an honest negative, not a reproduction of the published accuracies.
